name: consistency-violation-undeclared-data-description-elements
description: One change set whose every reference into the three element layers names nothing: an application type whose `unit_ref`, `compu_method_ref` and `data_constr_ref` name no declared element, and a linear compu method whose `unit` names no declared unit. Each is one of contract `8.0.0`'s four undeclared-target rules (`rule:data-type.unknown-unit`, `…unknown-compu-method`, `…unknown-data-constr` and `rule:compu-method.unknown-unit`), all four reported in one refusal.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model, whose three element layers are empty. The change set creates an application type and a linear method, each naming elements no layer declares.

authorization.notes: The scope covers every operation exactly, so the answer is the engine's and not the authorization boundary's.

input.intent: Declare the probe torque against elements that were never declared.

value.name: ProbeTorque
value.description: Probe torque naming three elements no layer declares

expected.notes: Pass D: every element and every reference is individually admissible, and the assembled staged result breaks a cross-element rule — `consistency-violation`, the code each undeclared-target rule of the element layers maps to. The primary is the type's `unit_ref` and `additional` carries the other three, each at the referrer's field and never at the target, which no layer declares.
